reply_text:
I’d block on one issue:

**[P1] Team and archive quotas become zero — `src/plans.js:11`.** JavaScript’s `<<` coerces values to 32-bit integers, so `entry.quotaKiB << 10` returns `0` for both plans instead of 200 GiB and 2 TiB. I reproduced a 1-byte upload being rejected on an empty account for each.

Use numeric multiplication (`entry.quotaKiB * 1024`) and add quota/upload tests for both larger plans before merging.

All four existing tests pass; they only exercise quota enforcement on the free plan. No code changed.
